resolved_findings: Release eligibility uses tuning validation; held-out metrics are reporting only.
Atomic registry replacement preserves the previous valid registry when interrupted before commit.
Active loading and rollback verify saved artifact, metadata, and dataset-manifest identities.
Duplicate candidate versions are rejected before dataset loading, fitting, or evaluation.
Malformed persisted metadata produces dependency-unavailable HTTP 503 responses.
Raw non-finite JSON numbers produce JSON-safe HTTP 422 responses.

checks.name: test suite and lint
checks.evidence: 15 tests passed at the reviewed revision; lint passed.

checks.name: gate partition and inverse probe
checks.evidence: Failing validation with perfect held-out results rejected; passing validation with failing held-out reporting remained eligible.

checks.name: actual interrupted registry mutation
checks.evidence: An isolated child process was killed immediately before atomic replacement. Prior registry bytes remained intact, the active model loaded, and later rollback succeeded.

checks.name: approved-file substitution
checks.evidence: A rejected model substituted under an approved version with internally recomputed metadata hashes was rejected by both rollback and active loading.

checks.name: serving contract
checks.evidence: All held-out rows matched direct model predictions despite reversed JSON key order; health, evidence, and actual prediction returned 200 from the bundled model.

checks.name: historical evidence preservation
checks.evidence: The original wine-logreg-v1 files and pre-correction receipts remained byte-identical and explicitly historical.

nonblocking_finding.issue: Repeated promotion of the already-active version could mark its status inactive while leaving active_version unchanged.
nonblocking_finding.resolution: Promotion now returns an idempotent no-op when the active approved identity is unchanged, preserving its status and history.
nonblocking_finding.verification: A focused regression promotes the same version twice, asserts identical registry bytes, active status, and unchanged history. The complete suite then passed with 16 tests.

root_note.scope: No API, model artifact, dataset split, evaluation result, or serving behavior changed.

limitations: Review approval covers local implementation and packaged artifact behavior, not public deployment success.
The registry uses unsigned local files and POSIX advisory locks; it is not distributed coordination or malicious local-writer protection.
The historical v1 registry identity is incomplete by design and cannot be loaded or used as a rollback target.
